description.value: Town Square is a community-focused full-service restaurant, food truck, and off-site catering operation at the centre of Pemberton, BC. The kitchen leans on locally sourced and organic ingredients from the Pemberton Valley, and the brunch menu stands out with eggs Benedict served on house-made bannock topped with house-cured salmon or locally sourced bison. Friday nights bring live music, cementing its role as a genuine gathering place for locals and travellers passing through the valley.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website fully corroborates the OSM address and phone number and confirms this is an active full-service restaurant with a food truck and catering arm. The website explicitly states gluten-free, vegetarian, and vegan options, consistent with OSM diet tags; OSM takeaway=yes aligns with the food truck described on site. No bike-specific amenities (rack, pump, charging, Wi-Fi) are mentioned on the website or in OSM tags, so those remain null; OSM opening hours differ from the website (OSM shows Monday open, website states 'Mon - Closed'), flagged in concerns.
concerns: OSM opening_hours tag shows Monday open (Mo-We 11:30-21:30) but the website explicitly states 'Mon - Closed'; OSM hours appear outdated.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Well-established community restaurant in Pemberton with full service, a food truck, dietary options (vegan, vegetarian, GF), and locally sourced food — a clear stop for touring cyclists on the Pemberton corridor.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Website states 'we offer Gluten free options, vegetarian and vegan!'
